subject: Civil Engineering
title: Precast Segmental Linings
description: A quick, practical guide to Precast Segmental Linings.

hook.text: TBM tunnels are lined with concrete puzzle pieces — each ring is assembled underground.

buildup.text: Precast segments are manufactured on the surface — precision-molded with steel reinforcement.

discovery.text: Six to eight segments bolt together to form one ring — each ring pushed forward by the TBM.

twist.text: Gaskets between segments seal against water — the lining must hold back enormous pressure.

climax.text: A single Crossrail tunnel installed over 100,000 segments — factory precision underground.

punchline.text: Build the tunnel like a puzzle — one ring at a time, miles underground.

quiz.question: How are precast segmental linings installed in a TBM tunnel?
options: Workers pour concrete into molds at the tunnel face
Pre-made segments are bolted together in rings behind the advancing TBM
The segments are lowered from the surface through vertical shafts

details.summary: Precast segmental linings are factory-produced curved concrete segments assembled into rings inside a TBM to form the permanent tunnel lining. Each ring typically consists of 5-8 segments plus a key piece.
details.whyItMatters: Segmental linings enable one-pass tunnel construction where the permanent structure is installed simultaneously with excavation, eliminating the need for separate temporary and permanent support phases.
takeaways: Segments are precision-manufactured in factories to tolerances within 1 millimeter
Gaskets between segments provide watertight seals under hydrostatic pressure
Ring assembly is automated and takes 30-60 minutes per ring inside the TBM

faq.question: How are precast segments designed to be both structural and watertight?
faq.answer: Segments are reinforced concrete designed to resist ground loads, TBM thrust forces, and handling stresses. EPDM rubber gaskets in grooves around each segment face compress during assembly to seal against water pressure.

faq.question: What happens if a segment is damaged during installation?
faq.answer: Minor cracks from handling are repaired with epoxy injection. Severe damage requires segment replacement before the ring advances. Quality control at the factory and careful handling procedures minimize damage. Segment design includes safety margins for construction-induced stresses.
